page.title: My wins
page.empty: When you win an auction, the order it created shows up here.

confirm.title: Confirm your wins
confirm.description: Pick a delivery address. One order is created per store.
confirm.declineConfirm: This gives up your win on this auction. Are you sure?
confirm.noAddress: You need a saved delivery address before confirming.

errors.WIN_EXPIRED: The confirmation window for this auction has closed.
errors.WIN_NOT_FOUND: That win is no longer available.

how.title: How winning works
how.created: When an auction ends in your favour, the order is created at once at your default address. There is nothing to confirm.
how.change: Pay on delivery, or electronically from the order page where it’s offered. The order keeps the address it was created with.
how.final: A win is a promise to buy. Declining a win counts as a violation, and repeated violations pause bidding.
how.noAddress: Add a delivery address: without one, a win can’t become an order.
